item.title: Mamdani touts landmark court victory against repeat offender landlord in housing enforcement push
item.summary: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani unveils landmark legal victory in housing crisis fight, securing maximum penalties against repeat offender landlord in groundbreaking case.

item.title: Soros-backed DA sparks backlash after blaming Old Dominion shooting on pro-gun lawmakers: 'F--- right off'

item.summary: Iran's military arm used dozens of fake social media accounts to push anti-Israel and anti-United States messages, according to a Clemson University report.

item.title: Transgender triple killer removed from home with 2 foster children months after authorities were notified

item.title: California shootings leave 2 deputies, utility worker injured; suspect also shot: officials
